CheckTitle: At least one active block zone exists for anonymizers or risky proxies
Description: Checks that at least one active network block zone targets anonymizer, proxy, VPN, or Tor categories.
Risk: Risky proxy and anonymizer traffic can hide credential attacks and automation.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Security > Networks.
2. Create a dynamic or enhanced dynamic zone for anonymizers or risky proxy categories.
3. Configure the zone to block or deny matching sign-in traffic.
4. Activate the zone and test expected access paths.
5. Review logs for false positives and document any approved exceptions.

Recommendation.Text: Create an active block zone for anonymizers, risky proxies, or similar high-risk proxy categories.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
